p: The single “approved” flow of history that the TVA protected.
Alternate versions of the same person from different timelines, like the many Lokis or Kangs.
Deadpool & Wolverine revealed that some universes depend on one key person. Earth-10005's anchor was Logan, and his death started that world's decay.
Moments when someone strays from their destined path and spawns a new branch.
The Time Variance Authority, the agency that once pruned every branch.
The being who created the TVA to stop his own dangerous variants, the Kangs.
